label: SaaS
title: SaaS Development
description: We build scalable SaaS platforms from zero to production, with modern architecture, robust authentication, integrated billing and a complete admin panel. From MVP to enterprise scale.
longDescription: We turn your idea into a complete SaaS platform, ready to scale. From concept to deployment, we deliver multi-tenant systems with enterprise-grade authentication, Stripe billing, guided onboarding and role-based dashboards. With the SystemForge methodology you ship in weeks — not months — with enterprise quality from the first commit. You focus on the product; we solve architecture, performance and security.

benefits.description: Core features in production fast, without months of planning.

benefits.title: Architecture built to scale

process.title: Discovery & Architecture
process.description: We map requirements, define the data model and choose the ideal stack for your use case.

process.title: MVP to production
process.description: We build core features and ship a functional version for validation with real users.

process.title: Iteration & expansion
process.description: We incorporate feedback, add features and optimise performance as the user base grows.

process.title: Documented handoff
process.description: We deliver documented code, configured CI/CD and a trained team ready to evolve the product.

useCases: Startups validating a product with an MVP and looking for their first paying customers
B2B companies that want to turn an internal process into a marketable product
Businesses with an analogue product that need a scalable digital version

faq.q: What is the difference between SaaS and a regular web app?
faq.a: A SaaS is designed for multiple customers (multi-tenant) with automated billing and self-service onboarding. A regular web app typically serves a single client with manual access.

faq.q: Do you hand over the source code?
faq.a: Yes, 100%. All code is yours. We deliver the complete repository, technical documentation and configured CI/CD so you have full control.

faq.q: How long until I have a working MVP?
faq.a: For a defined scope, the core MVP is ready in 4–8 weeks. Projects with more integrations and modules are ready in 8–16 weeks.

label: Mobile App
title: Mobile Applications
description: We develop high-quality iOS and Android apps using React Native or Flutter. From prototyping to store submission, with a focus on native performance and UX.
longDescription: We build mobile apps that users actually use — with native performance on iOS and Android from a single codebase. From prototype to store publication, we handle push notifications, onboarding, biometric authentication and API integrations. Every app is designed for retention: clean UX, fast loading and flows that convert. Post-publication support and continuous updates included.

benefits.title: UX that retains

benefits.title: Store submission
benefits.description: We manage the entire submission process for the App Store and Google Play.

process.title: Wireframes & prototype
process.description: We define the main flows and validate the UX before writing a single line of code.

process.title: Development & testing
process.description: We code, test on real devices and fix issues before submission.

process.title: Store submission
process.description: We submit to the stores, manage the review process and follow through to approval.

process.title: Monitoring & updates
process.description: We track crashes, collect feedback and release updates continuously.

useCases: Companies with field operations that need an app for external teams
B2C startups that need native presence on users' phones
Businesses with a web platform that want to expand to mobile

faq.q: React Native or Flutter — which do you use?
faq.a: We use React Native as standard for its ecosystem maturity and ease of integration with web stacks. Flutter for projects requiring highly custom UI or intensive graphical performance.

faq.q: Does the app work offline?
faq.a: Yes, when needed. We implement local caching, background sync and offline action queues with automatic conflict resolution.

faq.q: How long does store approval take?
faq.a: Google Play averages 1–3 days. App Store is usually 2–7 days on first submission. We manage the process and handle any rejections.

longDescription: We build landing pages that turn visitors into customers — and customers into fans. useCases: Product or service launches that need to capture leads quickly
Companies without a professional online presence that are losing credibility
Businesses with a slow or non-indexed site that don't show up on Google

faq.q: Will the landing page be on my domain?
faq.a: Yes. We publish on your domain, configure DNS and you have full control of the server and files.

faq.q: Can I edit the content later?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver with an integrated CMS (or simple panel) so you can edit text, images and calls to action without technical help.

faq.q: How do revisions work?
faq.a: We include 2 revision rounds in the scope. Each round covers layout, text and functionality through to full approval.

label: E-commerce

description: We develop complete e-commerce stores with product catalogues, shopping cart, payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), inventory management and a sales dashboard.
longDescription: We build online stores that actually sell. We develop custom e-commerce from scratch with mobile-optimised checkout, integrations with leading payment gateways, inventory management and an intuitive admin panel. We apply conversion best practices in every detail: from the purchase flow to abandoned cart recovery emails. Sell more with less friction for the customer — and less dependency on generic platforms that take a cut of every sale.

benefits.title: More conversions

benefits.description: Stripe, PayPal, Klarna and local options — no extra commission beyond processor fees.

benefits.title: Sales dashboard

process.title: Payment integrations

process.title: Logistics & notifications

process.title: Panel & training

useCases: Brick-and-mortar retailers that want to expand into digital with their own shop
Brands selling on marketplaces that want a direct channel without commissions
Info-product creators or service businesses that need their own checkout and subscriptions

faq.q: Can I migrate my store from Shopify or WooCommerce?
faq.a: Yes. We migrate products, customers and order history while preserving SEO and URLs. The process includes a parallel testing period to guarantee zero downtime.

faq.q: Does the store accept buy-now-pay-later?
faq.a: Yes. We configure Klarna or Stripe Installments to offer instalment payments without managing credit risk.

faq.q: What if my store grows a lot?
faq.a: The architecture is designed for volume. We have delivered stores that handle Black Friday peaks without downtime — with CDN, catalogue caching and a database optimised for product queries.

label: B2B Dashboard

longDescription: We transform raw data into actionable insights with high-performance B2B dashboards. We develop panels with real-time charts, tables with advanced filters, Excel and PDF exports, and granular role-based permissions. Our approach connects diverse sources — databases, external APIs, spreadsheets — into a unified interface that the team actually uses. The result: less time in analysis, faster decisions and clarity on where to focus efforts.

benefits.title: Role-based permissions

benefits.title: Automated exports
benefits.description: PDF and Excel reports generated and emailed on a scheduled basis.

benefits.title: Multi-source data
benefits.description: We connect databases, external APIs, spreadsheets and ERPs into a single view.

process.title: KPI mapping

process.title: Modelling & sources
process.description: We structure the data model and connect all information sources.

process.title: Interface & visualisations
process.description: We develop the panel with intuitive UX, prioritising information reading speed.

process.title: Alerts & automation
process.description: We configure alerts for critical KPIs and automatic email reports.

useCases: Operations with large data volumes that need consolidated visibility
Sales and marketing teams that need real-time channel metrics
Managers who currently rely on manual spreadsheets to make decisions

faq.q: Do you integrate with my current database?
faq.a: Yes. We connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery and other sources via API or direct connection — without migrating your data.

faq.q: Is the dashboard real-time?
faq.a: It depends on data volume. For high-frequency operations we use WebSockets. For management reports, polling every 30–60 seconds already delivers excellent performance.

faq.q: Can I customise the charts later?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver a configuration panel where managers can create visualisations, filters and reports without additional development.

label: API & Integrations
title: APIs & Integrations
description: We develop robust REST and GraphQL APIs, integrations with ERPs, CRMs, payment gateways and any external system. Process automation via webhooks and event-driven architecture.
longDescription: We build the integration layer that makes your systems talk to each other. We develop well-documented RESTful and GraphQL APIs, reliable webhooks, data transformation middleware and connectors for ERP, CRM and third-party platforms. Every API we deliver has robust authentication, rate limiting, audit logs and OpenAPI documentation. For legacy integrations, we create adapters that modernise communication without requiring refactoring of the existing system.

benefits.title: OpenAPI documented
benefits.description: Every API delivered with interactive documentation so your team integrates without support.

benefits.title: Security by default
benefits.description: OAuth2, API keys, rate limiting and audit logs included in every project.

benefits.title: Testing sandbox
benefits.description: Isolated environment for integration tests with no risk of affecting production data.

benefits.title: Legacy connectors
benefits.description: We integrate with legacy systems via adapters, no refactoring required.

process.title: System mapping
process.description: We survey all systems involved, data formats and integration points needed.

process.title: API contract
process.description: We define endpoints, schemas and contracts before writing code — avoiding rework.

process.title: Development & testing
process.description: We implement with automated contract and integration tests in a sandbox environment.

process.title: Production monitoring
process.description: We configure alerts for failures, latency and abnormal request volumes.

useCases: Companies with multiple systems (ERP, CRM, e-commerce) that don't talk to each other
Businesses that need to expose functionality to partners or customers via API
Operations with manual data transfer processes between platforms

faq.q: Do you integrate with SAP, Salesforce or other large ERPs?
faq.a: Yes. We have experience with SAP Business One, Salesforce and HubSpot. We use official APIs when available or database connectors when necessary.

faq.q: How do you ensure the integration won't break?
faq.a: With automated contract tests, uptime monitoring and proactive alerts. We also implement circuit breakers so a failure in one system doesn't bring down the others.

faq.q: What if the external system changes its API?
faq.a: We set up version monitoring and you receive an alert before the change affects production. Breaking change updates are covered under the maintenance plan.

longDescription: We integrate artificial intelligence into your operation with measurable ROI. We develop agents with GPT-4, Claude and open-source models to automate customer support, document analysis, report generation and data classification. We don't deliver demos — we deliver solutions that run in production, reduce operational costs and scale with the business. From prototyping to cloud deployment, we accompany every step to ensure the AI works in your real context.

benefits.title: Reduced operational cost

benefits.title: Real-time monitoring

process.title: Prototyping & validation

process.title: Development & integration
process.description: We implement the solution integrated with your existing systems with security and traceability.

process.title: Monitoring & improvement
process.description: We track quality, cost and model performance — adjusting continuously.

Teams that lose hours daily analysing and classifying documents

faq.q: Will AI replace my team?
faq.a: No — it will amplify their capabilities. AI handles repetitive, low-value tasks so people can focus on decisions, relationships and creativity.

faq.q: Is my data safe?
faq.a: Yes. We use APIs with confidentiality agreements, never train models on your data without consent and can host models on-premise when required.

faq.q: How much does running an AI agent cost?
faq.a: It depends on volume. A support agent with 1,000 interactions per month typically costs between $50 and $250 in API credits. We provide a detailed estimate before development.

You launch a functional marketplace — we ensure technology is never the bottleneck for growth.

faq.q: Do you use Stripe Connect for the split?
faq.a: Stripe Connect is our standard solution for international marketplaces. For region-specific needs, we also work with specialised marketplace PSPs.

faq.q: How does vendor onboarding work?
faq.a: We create a self-service flow with document validation, bank account setup and store configuration. Vendors are active within 24 hours of approval.

faq.q: What about invoicing and tax compliance?
faq.a: We integrate with invoice automation solutions (Taxjar, Avalara) to automate invoicing per order. Tax compliance is defined on a case-by-case basis with your accountant.

longDescription: We build management systems that understand the rules of your industry — not generic solutions you have to adapt to. faq.q: Why build a custom ERP instead of using SAP or Salesforce?
faq.a: Generic ERPs have expensive licences and force you to adapt your process to the software. A custom ERP costs less long-term and is exactly what your operation needs.

faq.q: How long until the system is running?
faq.a: Depending on complexity, the first functional module is ready in 6–10 weeks. We deliver in phases so the operation doesn't stop during the transition.

faq.q: Can I keep using my current system during the transition?
faq.a: Yes. We run systems in parallel during the validation period. Migration is gradual by module, with no big bang cutover.

label: Bots & Automations
title: Chatbots & Customer Support
description: We create intelligent chatbots for WhatsApp Business, Telegram and web with conversational AI, CRM integration and handoff to human agents when needed.
longDescription: We automate first-line support and lead qualification with chatbots that understand context and integrate with your CRM. Available 24/7 on WhatsApp Business, Telegram and web, with a smooth handoff to human agents when the situation requires. Every bot is trained with your knowledge base, brand voice and business rules — not a generic chatbot. You reduce support costs and increase response speed without sacrificing quality.

benefits.title: 24/7 support
benefits.description: Answers questions and qualifies leads at any hour, without on-call costs.

benefits.title: Intelligent handoff

benefits.title: CRM integration

Businesses with support teams overloaded by repetitive questions

faq.q: Does the chatbot use AI or rule-based flows?
faq.a: We combine both: structured flows for predictable processes (order status, FAQ) and conversational AI for open-ended questions. The result is more reliable and cheaper than pure AI.

faq.q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
faq.a: Yes for high volume. The official API is required for business accounts with over 1,000 messages per month. We assist with the Meta approval process.

faq.q: How does the bot learn over time?
faq.a: We review conversations weekly in the first few weeks and update the knowledge base. For high volumes, we implement automatic fine-tuning with human approval.

faq.q: What is the typical format of a consulting engagement?
faq.a: It starts with 1–3 days of assessment (interviews and code analysis), followed by a report delivered within 5 business days with prioritised recommendations and effort estimates.

faq.q: Do you also execute the recommendations?
faq.a: Yes, when it makes sense. Many clients engage us first for consulting and then for execution. This ensures the work is done by those who understand the problem deeply.

faq.q: Do you work with remote teams?
faq.a: 100% remote. We work with teams in the US, UK, Brazil and Italy. All deliverables are documented in English or the client's preferred language.

label: Desktop
title: Desktop Applications
description: We develop desktop applications that run on Windows, macOS and Linux from a single codebase with Electron. Offline support, background sync and local hardware integration.
longDescription: We develop robust desktop applications that run on Windows, macOS and Linux from a single codebase with Electron. Our apps support offline operation, background synchronisation, automatic OTA updates and integration with local peripherals such as printers, barcode scanners and scales. For internal systems and industrial operations that require reliability over connectivity, desktop is the right choice — we deliver it with modern web development speed.

benefits.title: Local hardware
benefits.description: Integration with printers, barcode scanners, scales and card readers.

benefits.title: Offline-first
benefits.description: Works without internet and syncs automatically when the connection returns.

benefits.title: Automatic updates
benefits.description: New versions installed silently without interrupting the user.

benefits.title: One codebase, three platforms
benefits.description: Windows, macOS and Linux from the same code — no duplicate development.

process.title: Hardware requirements
process.description: We map local peripheral integrations and OS access requirements.

process.title: Offline-first architecture
process.description: We design the local data model, sync strategy and conflict resolution.

process.title: Development & testing

process.title: Distribution & updates
process.description: We configure the build pipeline, code signing and automatic update distribution.

useCases: Industrial operations with barcode readers or scales on the factory floor
Point-of-sale (POS) systems that need to function without internet
Internal tools for teams working in environments with unreliable connectivity

faq.q: Why Electron and not native?
faq.a: Electron lets us reuse all web development expertise, delivering in half the time and cost. For most enterprise use cases, the performance is more than sufficient.

faq.q: How do automatic updates work?
faq.a: We use electron-updater with a configured update server. The app checks for updates on launch, downloads in the background and installs on next restart — transparent to the user.

faq.q: Does the app need to be digitally signed?
faq.a: Yes, for distribution without security warnings on Windows and macOS. We include code signing with a certificate in the build and publishing process.
